none: PAS NLM-60D201: roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, Lyons mint; possibly issue of 332. RIC volume 7 no. 255. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS. In exergue: ellipse with dot in its upper part followed by PLG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified…
